title: cli: a refused ownership boot rotates the restored telemetry shard; the printed apply command has no --out
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

## What is wrong
Rows 17 and 20 (record #32953 §1). These are findings A-2 and A-3 of #32102 (closed), and no card carried them:
- **A-3**: a boot that the organization-ownership guard refuses still runs telemetry retention and rotates the restored telemetry shard. A refused boot changes data.
- **A-2**: the apply command the refusal prints has no `--out`.
- #32953 R6 asks whether a refused boot should run retention at all.

## Do
- A boot the guard refuses makes no writes. That includes retention and shard rotation. This follows the fail-closed rule, so the lane can fix it without asking. Raise it on this card only if the code shows a reason it must run.
- Print a complete apply command.

## Grade
Restored telemetry rows can be lost (p1). Reach is limited to a refused boot after a restore (−1), so **p2**.

## Reader
`domain:server`, pilot **Area A5** (cli).
